 Judgment
1.
This Appeal is filed by the respondent in the LAR challenging the enhancement given by the Reference Court.
An extent of 0.75 Ares of land belonging to the respondent/claimant was acquired for Kallada Irrigation Project as per Section 4(1) Notification dated 11.02.1982 under The Land Acquisition Act, 1894.
The Land Acquisition Officer awarded compensation fixing the land value at Rs.2,424/- per Are.

The claimant filed an Application under Section 28A of the LA Act before the District Collector and the District Collector awarded compensation fixing the land value @
Rs.5,455/- per Are for 0.55 Ares and Rs.890.17/- for 0.20 Ares.
2.
The Reference Court awarded compensation fixing the land value @ Rs.6,000/- per Are for the entire land.

3. When the matter was taken for consideration, the learned Senior Government Pleader Sri. Rekha C. Nair confirmed that, as against the judgments in LAR No.49/2014 & 9/2016, which LA.APP. NO.
112 OF 2020 2025:KER:40818 were disposed of along with LAR No.34/2014 as per the common judgment disposing of 7 LARs, the State has not filed any appeal.
In the said case also, the Reference Court had fixed land value @ Rs.6,000/- per Are.
Even though the Reference Court has fixed a uniform rate of Rs.6,000/- for all the categories of land, I do not find any ground or reason to interfere with the judgment passed by the Reference Court.

Sd/-
